g.title: sheet
g.text: MICA 3.0 development | 17 / 20 | Complete implemented SoC integration
ISA 2.0 compatibility baseline | Enabled SoC interfaces | implemented RTL
RTL source set 5fbe88e7b5ecdbe5 | internal clock: clk_i rising edge; reset: rst_ni active low
Instance interfaces are generated from elaborated mica_soc connections; all port widths and directions are recorded.
CPU requests pass through real address decode and response selection in mica_soc.
UART RX, CRC and watchdog are enabled here. Standalone SPI is not falsely attached to this SoC.
Blue: data. Dashed gray: control/handshake. Red: fault. Repeated Nxx labels connect without a wire. Crossings do not join.

g.title: fabric
g.text: Repeated labels are the same elaborated net.
Nxxx labels identify anonymous generated nets;
exact bit IDs and RTL names are in soc-connectivity.json.
